attchmntText: M. K. Sons Fine Jewels Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
sm_name: M. K. Sons Fine Jewels Limited
voiceSummary: M. K. Sons Fine Jewels Limited filed a notice regarding the publication of newspaper advertisements for its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended on 30th September 2026. The advertisements were published in Mumbai Lakshdeep and Financial Express on 26th November 2026. The company also disclosed that it has invoked security measures under the SARFAESI Act, 2002, and the Security Interest Enforcement Rules, 2002. This action was taken against borrowers Sanket Patil and Bhaskar Parajamp, who reside in Raigad, Maharashtra. The company issued a demand notice for the recovery of Rs. 2,52,99,21/- due on 11th May 2026. The notice required repayment within 60 days. The company stated that if the dues are not cleared, it may take possession of the secured assets. The borrowers were informed of their right to appeal to the Debt Recovery Tribunal.

attchmntText: M. K. Sons Fine Jewels Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 24, 2026, titled "PRESS RELEASE".
sm_name: M. K. Sons Fine Jewels Limited
voiceSummary: M.K. Sons Fine Jewels Limited announced unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Total income for the first half of FY27 was Rs. 2,634.16 million, up 44.72% from Rs. 1,820.15 million in the prior year. Profit after tax stood at Rs. 307.78 million, an 84.98% increase from Rs. 166.38 million. For Q2 FY27, total income was Rs. 1,619.67 million and PAT was Rs. 157.62 million. The company plans to open new stores in Mumbai and expand an existing store in Q4. It is also expanding into the B2B segment under the brand Jewelista to diversify revenue streams. The company thanked investors for the response to its Initial Public Offering.

attchmntText: M. K. Sons Fine Jewels Limited has informed the Exchange about Outcome of Board Meeting
sm_name: M. K. Sons Fine Jewels Limited
voiceSummary: M. K. Sons Fine Jewels Limited approved its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 24, 2026. Revenue from operations for the quarter was 1,619.56 million INR, with a profit after tax of 157.62 million INR. For the half year, revenue was 2,633.95 million INR, and profit after tax was 307.78 million INR. The company completed its Initial Public Offering of 1,70,00,000 equity shares at Rs. 162 per share. The shares were listed on the National Stock Exchange and Bombay Stock Exchange on November 04, 2026. The financial results were reviewed by Paresh Rakesh and Associates LLP.
